🦾 A list of reported app support for Apple Silicon as well as Apple M4 and M3 Ultra Macs
The all-in-one bootable USB creator for Mac

Widelands is a free, open source real-time strategy game with singleplayer campaigns and a multiplayer mode. The game was inspired by Settlers II™ (© Bluebyte) but has significantly more variety and depth to it.

Every display control macOS hides, in one menu bar app: sharp HiDPI/Retina scaling (no more blurry or tiny text), DDC brightness and volume, Extra Brightness past 100%, presets, virtual displays. Free and open source, a no-cost alternative to BetterDisplay and Lunar.
Run Windows games on Apple Silicon — free, open source, with an open compatibility database that tells you what actually works.
Local AI app and inference engine for agents. Run open-weight LLMs locally — private, 100% offline on your computer. Join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/8wGSsvmg4V
Local speech-to-text for macOS  on-device AI, fully private, optional cloud
Wallpaper Engine wallpapers on your Mac. A free, open-source app that plays scene, video and web wallpapers from the Steam Workshop. Apple silicon, macOS 15+.
Sudoless Apple Silicon system monitor (native SwiftUI GUI) with ANE / Media Engine / memory-bandwidth tracking
Active community fork of the archived whisky-app/whisky — a modern Wine wrapper for macOS built with SwiftUI
红果短剧桌面版 · 支持 M 系列 Mac、Intel Mac 和 Windows · 三来源搜索、播放、下载与追剧 · GPL-3.0 开源

Run Android apps on your Mac like Mac apps: each in its own window with its own Dock icon, on Apple silicon. Notifications, game controllers, privacy controls. Free & open source (LineageOS + QEMU + scrcpy).
Control Xiaomi Mijia from your Mac menu bar or Windows tray. Home Assistant supported on macOS.
A small, quiet system monitor for Apple Silicon Macs: one floating glass panel that works at any size.

Native Safari browser automation for AI agents. 98 tools via AppleScript — zero overhead, keeps logins, runs silently in background. Drop-in alternative to Chrome DevTools MCP with 40-60% less CPU/heat on Apple Silicon.
Private, local transcription and system-wide dictation for Apple Silicon.

Free, sub-second on-device AI dictation for macOS. Dual engines (Whisper + Parakeet) on Apple Silicon. Optional AI polish on your Mac with EG-1 or S1-mini by Superwhisper, Apple Intelligence (macOS 26), Ollama, or your own OpenAI/Gemini/Claude key. Snippets, custom words, no account, no subscription, audio never leaves your Mac.
M-Courtyard: Local AI Model Fine-tuning Assistant for Apple Silicon. Zero-code, zero-cloud, privacy-first desktop app powered by Tauri + React + mlx-lm.

A local-first workspace for documents, tasks and meetings on macOS — nested spaces, typed properties, relations and saved views, with transcription, Smart Minutes and an agent running entirely on-device via MLX on Apple Silicon
Free, open-source macOS app that locks applications with Touch ID, Apple Watch, and trusted Wi-Fi. The only open-source app locker for macOS.
Fast, open-source, GPU-rendered file manager for macOS. A Finder alternative built in Rust with GPUI.
Open-source Apple Silicon system monitor for macOS.
Native YouTube & YouTube Music player for Mac (macOS). Lightweight client with 4K VideoToolbox acceleration, SponsorBlock, synced lyrics, local audio & trackpad edge volume.

Thai + English voice typing for Mac. Offline speech-to-text that types Thai-spoken tech words in English. Push-to-talk dictation on Apple Silicon (Whisper + MLX), free & open-source Wispr Flow alternative · พิมพ์ด้วยเสียงภาษาไทย

Free, open-source disk space analyzer for macOS, inspired by WinDirStat. See what's taking up space on your Mac with an interactive treemap and track down large files. Native SwiftUI app for Apple silicon and Intel, signed and notarized, fully offline.
The free, open-source meeting-notes app for your Mac — offline transcription and AI notes, free in the cloud or 100% on-device.
Native open-source system monitor for macOS — Apple Silicon, SMC sensors, processes, disks, network and system health.
👋 Your face is the password. Face unlock for your Mac's lock screen, plus App Lock for chosen apps. 100% on-device, built with Swift and Core ML.
Turn a Mac mini into a living-room retro/PS console - beautiful big-picture launcher (Electron + React)
Mac-native dictation that just works – lives in the notch, zero setup, free forever
A native macOS downloader built on yt-dlp. Paste a link, get the file — and drive it from your phone over your own Wi-Fi.
A native macOS app for managing Apple's container - build images, run machines, and tail logs from a real GUI.
Lightweight open-source macOS menu bar monitor for CPU, memory, storage, GPU, and network usage, built with Rust and Tauri.

Voice dictation menu-bar app for macOS. Press a hotkey, speak, transcript appears at the cursor. Whisper runs locally via WhisperKit on Apple Silicon — no audio, text, or telemetry leaves your Mac. MIT, Swift.
Hands-free on-device voice loop for macOS: Apple SFSpeechRecognizer + cloned-voice TTS, continuous listening, zero cloud. Originally built to drive claude-code-local.
Fast, private push-to-talk dictation for Apple Silicon Macs — local Parakeet TDT v3, no cloud or telemetry.
A rust mlx server, ui, and model router for fast, dependency free inference on apple architecture
Native macOS workspace for Apple's container runtime. Browse, run, build and clean up Linux containers with live resource gauges, a built-in terminal and a local MLX chat playground.
Native macOS menu bar system monitor — CPU, memory, network, temps, fans & power. The popular GNOME tool Vitals, for the Mac.
See what your Mac is doing and keep its battery healthy with a charge limit. Free, open source and native.

Free, open-source CleanMyMac alternative for macOS. Native SwiftUI disk cleaner for app caches, node_modules, Xcode DerivedData, Docker and AI tool caches (Codex, Claude Code, Ollama) - nothing is ever really deleted: it all goes to the Trash and stays undoable. No telemetry, no subscription.
Free, open-source, offline file converter for macOS: drag files, tap a key, and convert, crop, compress or share them from a radial menu.
The macOS app for your circadian rhythm. Free, open-source, zero telemetry.
Native local-first macOS speech-to-text, live captions, subtitle editing, offline translation, and on-device Gemma 4 transcript enhancement.
Free, open-source game launcher toolkit for Apple Silicon Macs. Set up Battle.net, Steam, Epic and GOG with separate Wine environments, Mac launch shortcuts and documented compatibility.

Your coding agent starts every session with amnesia — memo fixes that, 100% on your machine. Persistent memory for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor & any MCP client: Markdown source of truth, hybrid search (MLX/CPU + sqlite-vec), time-machine, contradiction radar, nightly self-optimization. No cloud, no keys.
Free, open source Mac menu bar app for memory and disk. See what uses your RAM, keep a week of history, pause idle apps, find large files, and uninstall cleanly. No network access.
Customize the macOS Tahoe menu bar background with blur, tint, shadows, textures, presets, and per-Space settings!
Fast and simple local PDF compression for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Drag, drop, done.
原生 macOS 下载工具（SwiftUI）。统一管理磁力 / 种子 / ed2k、HTTP 与网盘直链，以及 YouTube、哔哩哔哩、抖音、小红书等平台的视频下载；支持浏览器扩展接管、边下边播、断点续传与 PikPak 云盘离线。基于 Gopeed 与 yt-dlp，GPL-3.0 开源。
Records lectures, meetings and calls and writes structured notes — transcription and AI run locally on your Mac. Free, open source, no account.
Lightweight, open-source macOS menu bar system monitor — CPU, memory, network, disk, GPU, temperatures, battery. No telemetry, Apple Silicon native.
A native macOS app that shows what's draining your battery — live power, per-app energy, charge history, and drain insights. 100% local, no dependencies.

Native macOS app for local AI image generation and editing on Apple silicon: Z-Image Turbo, Qwen-Image-2.1, Krea 2 Turbo, Anima Turbo and MOSS-Image in Swift and Metal, fp32, checked against diffusers. Never takes more memory than its budget: ¾ of the Mac's memory minus 2 GB.
MacFanPro: free, open-source fan control for Apple Silicon Macs, with a native menu bar app and 18 languages.
IPTV player for Mac, Windows, Android and Android TV: Xtream Codes and M3U, instant search, built-in mpv player, subtitles, Picture in Picture, catch-up. Open source, GPL-3.0.
Native Mac dictation in a 12 MB download. Free Local mode with Whisper + Parakeet, reproducible benchmarks, optional Cloud. MIT-licensed client.
Free live 4K wallpapers for Mac: about 590 space and nature loops plus Apple Aerials. Native SwiftUI, no account, no tracking.
Transcribe meetings, calls and dictation locally on your Mac – with speaker recognition, no cloud. Whisper + pyannote, menu bar app. German and English.
Free, open-source offline dictation and transcription for macOS. Dictate into any app, transcribe calls and files on-device, and give Claude Code, Codex and Cursor ears via a local MCP server.

Free, open-source alternative to CleanMyMac, in Rust. A menu bar system monitor with cache and log cleanup, an uninstaller, disk usage and startup items. Idles at about 9 MB of memory. Not affiliated with MacPaw.
A script to automate tasks when connect a device to your macbook
NotchMuse v0.8.0: synced macOS lyrics for Spotify, Apple Music, NetEase, QQ Music and Soda Music. Menu bar, notch, side and Dock lyrics with in-app updates.

Free, open-source Mac app for local transcription and dictation. Transcribe audio, video, YouTube and meetings with Whisper or Parakeet, fully offline. A MacWhisper and Wispr Flow alternative for Apple Silicon.
Free, open-source battery care for Apple Silicon MacBooks: charge limit, live power flow, long-term health.
Real macOS WiFi data for Go: scan unredacted SSIDs/BSSIDs and read saved WiFi passwords with user-approved macOS prompts.

Free, open-source app to swap a character in a video on Mac. No watermark. Seedance 2.5 or Wan 2.2 Animate with on-device prep (Vision, Core ML, MLX). A Viggle and Higgsfield Recast alternative. Unofficial.
Free, open-source fan control & temperature monitor for Apple Silicon Macs (M1–M5). Menu bar temps, Manual/Max/Auto Boost/curves, fail-safe helper. MIT, no network.
Kernel-level privacy protection & application locking tool for macOS built with Apple Endpoint Security
🫠 Your MacBook has feelings. Every hardware event triggers a personality response.

Offline dictation and file transcription for the Mac, in Rust. Works with NVIDIA's Parakeet models, other Parakeet models from Hugging Face, or Apple Speech. About 0.5 GB of memory with Parakeet Ultra loaded.
Free, open-source Codex usage tracker for the macOS menu bar: monitor 5-hour/weekly limits and reset times locally. 免费开源的 Codex 用量监控工具。
Free macOS menu-bar file converter: drag files, tap Shift, drop on a petal. HEIC/WebP/AVIF/PDF, MP4/MOV/GIF, audio, EPUB, OCR, compress, trim, annotate. Apple Silicon.
Menu-bar file converter for macOS 26+. Drag a file, a wheel appears, drop it on what you want: video, audio, images, PDFs and links.
Menu-bar panel for local LLM engines on macOS: run Splash or llama.cpp, watch memory and speed, get models from Hugging Face
Local AI models on your Mac, one click from your tools. A menu bar app for GGUF and MLX on Apple silicon.
Run the Windows version of Minecraft Bedrock Edition on Apple Silicon Macs fully offline.
Borne — MAME arcade and PC classics (Doom, Quake, Duke Nukem 3D…) on the Mac, in the spirit of MAMEUI. Native, free, GPL-3.0.
A fast, keyboard-driven image viewer for macOS with batch conversion. Native Swift.
A fast, private photo organizer for macOS: faces, search and editing, all on your Mac
Live subtitle translation for PS Remote Play on Mac — on-device, 20+ languages, plus a trophy hub.
